published_title: Beats of the Black Sun V  2
player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''eddiehectic''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Agents Of Black Sun]] list on DeckTech in March 2001.

starting.card: Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince

description: Use the new R2 objective to capture every character the LS has.  Fun to play with lots of cool bounty hunters and interupts.
cards: Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince
posted: Agents of the Black Sun v2
posted: Presence of the Force x2
posted: Jabba's through with you x3
shields_note: The post names no Defensive Shields.
notes: The list's first line 'Agents of the Black Sun v2' dested the Objective Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince: the description says 'Use the new R2 objective', the strategy refers to 'your objective' throughout, and with it the list totals 60 (59 without).

Starting cards as marked '(start)': Coruscant, Coruscant: Imperial City, Prince Xizor, Imperial Arrest Order, Mobilization Points, All Wrapped Up and Prepared Defenses, with the Objective; several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.

Posted ' DB' (the strategy's '<> DB', the '<>' lost from the list) dested the Dark Spaceport Docking Bay; 'Tat DB' Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'Rendilli' Rendili; 'Coruscant' and its sites are the Dark Special Edition cards.

Posted 'IGGY w/gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; '4-Lom w/gun' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Dengar w/gun' Dengar With Blaster Carbine; 'Boba w/gun' Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Bossk w/gun' Bossk With Mortar Gun; 'Palpy' Emperor Palpatine; 'Hell 2 Pay' There'll Be Hell To Pay.

Posted 'Weapon Vibro ax' (a one-card Weapon section) dested Vibro-Ax; 'All wrapped up' is the Jabba's Palace Effect All Wrapped Up. Resistance and Secret Plans are the 2001 Effects (not Defensive Shields).
